TaskDescription: Scene recognition memory task (Presentation 18.0): per block, study of 24 novel natural scenes (Microsoft COCO 2017 train images with people, animals or food; 8 per category) followed by a recognition test, with concurrent EyeLink 1000 eye tracking. Each run is one block as exported by the authors (file *_sl_block<N>.m00).
InstitutionName: Northwestern Memorial Hospital Comprehensive Epilepsy Center

BandpassFilter.Description: Recorded signals were bandpass-filtered from 0.6 to 600 Hz (Kragel et al. 2021)

iEEGReference: Clinical reference and ground: a surgically implanted electrode strip facing the scalp or a scalp electrode (Kragel et al. 2021); channel names give the reference label (REF1 / Ref1). Bipolar re-referencing and DFT line-noise removal of the paper were NOT applied.
ElectrodeManufacturer: AD-TECH Medical Instrument Co., Racine, WI
iEEGElectrodeInfo: Stereotactic EEG depth electrodes, contacts spaced 5 to 10 mm apart (Kragel et al. 2021)
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined depth electrodes with hippocampal coverage (inclusion criterion)
